issue.title: fix(time-format): short digit-only strings are formatted as epoch-millisecond offsets near 1970
issue.body:
## Problem

`stringifyTimeInput` (used by every `TimeFormatter`) treats any digit-only string that is not exactly four digits as an epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Temporal columns whose values are small integers or date keys — `7` (hour), `365` (day of year), `202609` (YYYYMM), `20240101` (YYYYMMDD) — are therefore rendered as moments a few milliseconds or hours after `1970-01-01` instead of being shown as-is. The pivot-table chart makes this worse: `toDateFormatterInput` in `TableRenderers.tsx` pre-coerces the same strings to `Number` before calling the formatter, so pivot row/column headers for such columns collapse to `1970-01-01 00:00:00` (or, for `20240101`, `1970-01-01 05:37:20`). The output is silently wrong and different rows become indistinguishable.

## Reproduction

Base: `7b6dd7597c4af49f7f0571b7b33dd247f382218b` (`origin/master`).

1. Utility level (no build needed):
   ```bash
   cd superset-frontend
   cat > /tmp/probe.ts <<'EOF'
   import stringifyTimeInput from './packages/superset-ui-core/src/time-format/utils/stringifyTimeInput';
   const iso = (d: Date) => d.toISOString();
   for (const v of ['7', '365', '202609', '20240101', '2024', '1000000000', '1700000000000'])
     console.log(JSON.stringify(v), '->', stringifyTimeInput(v, iso));
   EOF
   npx tsx /tmp/probe.ts
   ```
2. Chart level: render `plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table` via `transformProps` → `PivotTableChart` with `queriesData[0].coltypes = [GenericDataType.Temporal, GenericDataType.Numeric]`, `data = [{hour: 7, m: 1}, {hour: 365, m: 1}, {hour: 20240101, m: 1}]`, `groupbyRows = ['hour']`, `dateFormat = 'smart_date'` (or `'%Y-%m-%d'`), no time grain. This is the payload shape the backend produces for an integer `is_dttm` column without `python_date_format`.

## Current behavior

Step 1 prints:

```
"7"             -> 1970-01-01T00:00:00.007Z
"365"           -> 1970-01-01T00:00:00.365Z
"202609"        -> 1970-01-01T00:03:22.609Z
"20240101"      -> 1970-01-01T05:37:20.101Z
"2024"          -> 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
"1000000000"    -> 1970-01-12T13:46:40.000Z
"1700000000000" -> 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z
```

Step 2 renders row headers `1970-01-01 00:00:00`, `1970-01-01 00:00:00`, `1970-01-01 05:37:20` (with `%Y-%m-%d`: `1970-01-01` × 3).

## Expected behavior

- A digit-only string of fewer than 10 digits that is not the four-digit year form is returned verbatim by `stringifyTimeInput` (`"7"` → `"7"`, `"365"` → `"365"`, `"202609"` → `"202609"`, `"20240101"` → `"20240101"`, `"0"` → `"0"`, `"-1"` → `"-1"`).
- A four-digit string is still treated as an ISO year (`"2024"` → `2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`).
- A digit-only string of 10 or more digits is still treated as epoch milliseconds (`"1000000000"` → `1970-01-12T13:46:40.000Z`, `"1487071353000"` → `2017-02-14T11:22:33.000Z`).
- `toDateFormatterInput` in the pivot table only coerces strings matching `/^-?\d{10,}$/` to `Number`; shorter digit-only strings are passed through as strings so the shared formatter can return them untouched. Pivot headers for the step-2 payload render `7`, `365`, `20240101`.
- Non-digit strings (`"2017-02-14T11:22:33Z"`, `"00:01:54"`, `"square"`), `Date`, `number`, `null`, `undefined` inputs behave exactly as today.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `stringifyTimeInput('20240101', fn)`, `('202609', fn)`, `('7', fn)`, `('365', fn)`, `('0', fn)`, `('-1', fn)` each return the input string unchanged.
- [ ] `stringifyTimeInput('2024', fn)` still returns the year-start date (`2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` with an ISO formatter).
- [ ] `stringifyTimeInput('1000000000', fn)` and `('1487071353000', fn)` still format as epoch milliseconds.
- [ ] Pivot table `TableRenderer` passes `'20240101'` (string) — not `20240101` (number) — to a header date formatter, and still passes `1700000000000` (number) for `'1700000000000'`.
- [ ] Rendering the pivot table through `transformProps` with the step-2 payload shows row headers `7`, `365`, `20240101` and no `1970-01-01` header.
- [ ] All existing tests in `packages/superset-ui-core/test/time-format/` and `plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/test/react-pivottable/` still pass.

## Relevant code

- `superset-frontend/packages/superset-ui-core/src/time-format/utils/stringifyTimeInput.ts` — `stringifyTimeInput`; the `isYear` / `isIntegerString` branch is the defect. The existing `isYear` special case is the in-repo pattern for "digit-only string that is not an epoch".
- `superset-frontend/plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/src/react-pivottable/TableRenderers.tsx` — `toDateFormatterInput` (~lines 56–62); mirrors the same 4-digit exception and must adopt the same ≥10-digit rule.
- Tests demonstrating the current convention: `packages/superset-ui-core/test/time-format/utils/stringifyTimeInput.test.ts` (`treats a four-digit integer string as a year, not as milliseconds`; `treats an integer string as a timestamp in milliseconds`) and `plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/test/react-pivottable/tableRenders.test.tsx` (`TableRenderer coerces numeric timestamp strings to numbers for column header date formatters` / `…row header date formatters`).
- Reference implementation of the intended behavior: `apache/superset@66e64cc7d895800be1a5bbee4380650c85eebce7` (#44352) — not present in this fork.

## Scope

Frontend only: the string-classification logic in `stringifyTimeInput.ts`, the matching coercion guard in `TableRenderers.tsx`, and focused unit tests in the two existing test files above.

## Non-goals

- No refactoring of `TimeFormatter`, `DateWithFormatter`, `PivotData`, or other pivot-table renderers.
- No dependency upgrades, lockfile or `package.json` changes.
- No changes to generated files, `.github/workflows/`, Alembic migrations, or Python backend (`_collect_dttm_labels` / `extract_dataframe_dtypes` behavior stays as is).
- No change to how 4-digit years or ≥10-digit epochs are handled, and no new user-facing controls or feature flags.

## Validation

```bash
cd superset-frontend
npx jest packages/superset-ui-core/test/time-format/utils/stringifyTimeInput.test.ts
npx jest plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/test/react-pivottable/tableRenders.test.tsx
npx jest plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/test   # whole plugin test dir
npx eslint packages/superset-ui-core/src/time-format/utils/stringifyTimeInput.ts plugins/plugin-chart-pivot-table/src/react-pivottable/TableRenderers.tsx
npx tsx /tmp/probe.ts   # from Reproduction step 1; short digit-only inputs must echo back unchanged
```
